claims.claim: Pedro Sánchez dissolved Spain's Parliament on Monday after months of spiraling crises.
claims.episode_span: Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez dissolved Parliament on Monday
claims.source_title: Housing, Corruption and a Migrant Surge: Why Spain Is Holding an Early Election
claims.supporting_quote: Spain’s prime minister, Pedro Sánchez, dissolved Parliament on Monday, after months of spiraling crises.

claims.claim: Sánchez called an early election for 29 November after a fragmented parliament rejected key housing decrees last week amid protests, seeking to strengthen his mandate.
claims.episode_span: called an election for 29 November
claims.source_title: Spanish PM Sanchez calls snap election for Nov. 29
claims.supporting_quote: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez called an early election for Nov. 29 on Monday, in a bid to strengthen his mandate after a fragmented parliament rejected the government's key housing decrees last week amid widespread protests.

claims.claim: The euro fell as much as 0.8% on Monday to below $1.12, its lowest since May 2025, and is down about 1.2% this month from a January peak of $1.20.
claims.episode_span: the euro fell as much as 0.8% against the dollar on Monday to below $1.12
claims.source_title: Euro falls to 17-month low against dollar amid French debt fears
claims.supporting_quote: The single currency fell as much as 0.8% against the dollar in early trading on Monday to below $1.12, its lowest level since May 2025, before recovering slightly.

claims.claim: France's CAC 40 fell 1% on Monday while the FTSE 100 rose 0.2% and Germany's Dax was little changed.
claims.episode_span: the CAC 40 fell 1%, the FTSE 100 rose 0.2%, and Germany's Dax was little changed
claims.source_title: Euro falls to 17-month low against dollar amid French debt fears
claims.supporting_quote: France’s blue-chip Cac 40 index of leading company shares fell by 1% on Monday, as markets elsewhere across Europe rallied. The FTSE 100 was up 0.2%, while Germany’s Dax was little changed.

claims.claim: French 10-year yields hit their highest since 2002 last week, and the gap with German borrowing costs reached its widest since 2012.
claims.episode_span: French 10-year yields hit their highest since 2002 last week
claims.source_title: Euro falls to 17-month low against dollar amid French debt fears
claims.supporting_quote: the yield – in effect the interest rate – on French 10-year government bonds last week hit the highest level since 2002, before dipping back on Friday.

claims.claim: Sébastien Lecornu's minority government announced a €54bn savings drive.
claims.episode_span: announced a €54bn savings drive
claims.source_title: Euro falls to 17-month low against dollar amid French debt fears
claims.supporting_quote: The minority government of the French prime minister, Sébastien Lecornu, announced plans last month for a €54bn (£45.8bn) savings drive to curb borrowing levels, setting the stage for a fierce political battle.

claims.claim: India's Union Cabinet approved the ₹1.86 lakh crore Green Energy Corridor Phase-III, with ₹1.36 lakh crore for intra-state transmission and ₹50,000 crore for 50 GWh of battery storage.
claims.episode_span: approved the ₹1.86 lakh crore Green Energy Corridor Phase-III
claims.source_title: Union Cabinet approves ₹1.86 lakh crore Green Energy Corridor Phase-III
claims.supporting_quote: The Union Cabinet has given its nod to the ₹1.86 lakh crore Green Energy Corridor Phase-III (GEC-III), which is designed to close the geographic and temporal mismatch.

claims.claim: GEC-III is designed to evacuate up to 135 GW of renewable power and is targeted for completion by FY2032-33, with ₹54,082 crore in central support.
claims.episode_span: designed to evacuate up to 135 gigawatts and is targeted for completion by fiscal year 2032-33
claims.source_title: Union Cabinet approves ₹1.86 lakh crore Green Energy Corridor Phase-III
claims.supporting_quote: Through GEC-III — designed to evacuate up to 135 GW of renewable power and is targeted for completion by FY2032-33 — a larger share of renewable electricity is expected to reach the grid since production does not necessarily take place at the point of consumption.

claims.claim: India had commissioned 263 GW of renewable capacity by January 2026, with a policy to reach 500 GW by 2030, and the IEA expects electricity demand to grow 6.4% a year through 2030.
claims.episode_span: commissioned 263 gigawatts of renewable capacity by January 2026
claims.source_title: Union Cabinet approves ₹1.86 lakh crore Green Energy Corridor Phase-III
claims.supporting_quote: India had commissioned 263 GW renewable capacity by January 2026, while national policy is to reach 500 GW by 2030.

claims.claim: A WFP driver was killed Saturday when an airstrike hit two marked aid trucks between Dilling and Kadugli in South Kordofan; the WFP did not identify the attacker.
claims.episode_span: a World Food Program driver was killed on Saturday when an airstrike hit two contracted trucks
claims.source_title: Strike on WFP Aid Trucks in Sudan Kills One
claims.supporting_quote: One person was killed in an airstrike targeting a convoy carrying aid supplies in Sudan’s South Kordofan region on Saturday, the World Food Program (WFP) said.

claims.claim: Aid workers estimate more than 200,000 people killed and more than 11 million displaced since Sudan's war began in April 2023, and UN figures say drones killed more than 1,100 people in the first half of the year.
claims.episode_span: more than 200,000 people killed since the war began in April 2023
claims.source_title: Strike on WFP Aid Trucks in Sudan Kills One
claims.supporting_quote: Since the war began in April 2023, more than 200,000 people were killed, aid workers estimate, while more than 11 million are displaced, creating the world’s largest hunger and displacement crises.

claims.claim: Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel won the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for optogenetics and will share 12 million Swedish kronor.
claims.episode_span: the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine went to US psychiatrist Karl Deisseroth and German colleagues Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel
claims.source_title: Nobel Prize awarded for showing how nerve cells shape feelings
claims.supporting_quote: US psychiatrist and neurologist Karl Deisseroth and his German colleagues Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel have been awarded this year's Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for their work in the field of optogenetics.

claims.claim: Flávio Bolsonaro beat Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in Brazil's first round but lacked an outright majority, so they meet in a runoff on 25 October.
claims.episode_span: heads to a 25 October runoff after Flávio Bolsonaro beat President Lula without an outright majority
claims.source_title: Son of disgraced ex-president Jair Bolsonaro takes election lead in Brazil
claims.supporting_quote: Brazil’s presidential race will go to a second round after the far-right candidate, Flávio Bolsonaro, beat the incumbent leftwing president, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, but failed to secure the outright majority he needed to avoid a runoff.

claims.claim: The United States withdrew its aircraft from RAF Fairford, citing concerns about a potential attack.
claims.episode_span: the United States withdraw its aircraft from RAF Fairford, citing concern about a potential attack
claims.source_title: US abruptly withdraws bombers from UK’s RAF Fairford
claims.supporting_quote: The US has abruptly withdrawn all of its aircraft from the UK’s RAF Fairford, citing concerns about a potential attack.

claims.claim: Spanish police moved more than 3,000 migrants from a camp on Ceuta's Trampolín Beach to a temporary reception centre.
claims.episode_span: police move more than 3,000 migrants from a beach camp to a reception centre
claims.source_title: Spanish police remove over 3,000 migrants from Ceuta beach camp
claims.supporting_quote: Police dismantle a migrant camp on Ceuta’s Trampolín Beach, moving over 3,000 people from tents to a temporary reception centre for processing.

claims.claim: Quebec's nine million people vote on 5 October, with the campaign focused more on Donald Trump's tariffs than on independence.
claims.episode_span: Quebec, in North America, votes today, its campaign turned more on President Trump's tariffs than on independence
claims.source_title: Quebec heads to the polls with focus more on Trump than independence
claims.supporting_quote: The predominantly French-speaking Canadian province of Quebec goes to the polls on Monday and while a separatist party looks set to win, the campaign's focus has been more on US President Donald Trump than on independence.

claims.claim: The US Supreme Court will weigh a bid by Suncor and ExxonMobil to avoid a climate lawsuit, and the Trump administration has backed the oil companies.
claims.episode_span: its Supreme Court weigh Suncor and ExxonMobil's climate-suit bid, backed by the Trump administration
claims.source_title: U.S. Supreme Court to weigh bid by Suncor, ExxonMobil to avoid climate lawsuit
claims.supporting_quote: Trump administration has backed oil companies, arguing Washington’s authority to regulate air pollution precludes state’s claims

claims.claim: Campaigners handed 85,000 signatures in Bern on 5 October seeking a Swiss referendum on the EFTA-Malaysia trade deal, which needs 50,000 valid signatures.
claims.episode_span: Campaigners handed 85,000 signatures to parliament in Bern on 5 October
claims.source_title: Switzerland set for referendum on Malaysia trade deal
claims.supporting_quote: Campaigners handed in 85,000 signatures at the Parliament buildings in the Swiss capital Bern on Oct 5, public broadcaster RTS said.

claims.claim: The Alliance Against Tropical Deforestation says the deal would lower tariffs on 12.5 million kg of palm oil without effective measures against deforestation and forced labour.
claims.episode_span: lower tariffs on 12.5 million kilograms of palm oil without effective measures
claims.source_title: Switzerland set for referendum on Malaysia trade deal
claims.supporting_quote: The agreement “plans to lower tariffs on 12.5 million kg of palm oil, without effective measures against rainforest deforestation and forced labour”, the alliance says.

claims.claim: Renewables contributed 17% of India's electricity generation in FY2025-26, compared with 14% the previous fiscal, according to Central Electricity Authority data cited by The Hindu.
claims.episode_span: renewables contributed 17% of India's electricity generation in fiscal year 2025-26, compared with 14%
claims.source_title: Union Cabinet approves ₹1.86 lakh crore Green Energy Corridor Phase-III
claims.supporting_quote: The Central Electricity Authority’s (CEA) data shows that the renewables contributed 17% of electricity generation in FY2025-26 compared to 14% the previous fiscal, while reports suggest that renewable sources account for more than 50% of India’s installed power capacity.
